summary_en: This Phase 1b study tests MRX-2843 given together with osimertinib in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer that has an EGFR gene mutation. Both drugs are taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 28, and each 28-day cycle repeats while the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The study measures side effects and the best dose, and it is a Phase 1b safety and pharmacodynamic study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa MRX-2843 combinado con osimertinib en pacientes con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado que tiene una mutación del gen EGFR. Ambos medicamentos se toman por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 28, y cada ciclo de 28 días se repite mientras la enfermedad no progrese y los efectos secundarios sean aceptables. El estudio mide los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis, y es un estudio de fase 1b de seguridad y farmacodinámica.
who_for: Metastatic (spread) non-small cell lung cancer with an activating EGFR mutation.
Blood counts, liver and kidney tests within the limits stated.
Cohort rules: treatment-naive for one expansion cohort; progression on certain EGFR TKIs for another.
Able to swallow oral medication and sign written consent.
not_for: Chemotherapy or radiotherapy within 4 weeks (6 weeks for nitrosoureas or mitomycin C).
Known interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
QTc over 500 msec, cardiomyopathy, or LVEF under 50%.
